newsitem.title: USA: Questron seeks one-for-10 reverse split.
newsitem.headline: Questron seeks one-for-10 reverse split.

text.p: Questron Technology Inc said on Wednesday it was seeking shareholder approval for a one-for-10 reverse stock split of its issued and outstanding common stock.
The specialized distributor of fasteners and electronic hardware also said it sought approval of reductions in the authorized common and preferred stock, in view of the proposed reverse stock split.
Questron said it filed preliminary proxy materials with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission in connection with its December annual shareholder meeting.
